title: Repeat with a counter
summary: Assembly: Repeat with a counter. Start the counter at 4.
introduction: A label names a place in the code. jnz repeats while the last result was not zero.
learningObjectives: Repeat with a counter with Assembly

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Repeat with a counter
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rcx, 3
    mov rdi, 0
.again:
    add rdi, 2
    dec rcx
    jnz .again
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: The loop adds 2 three times. The decreasing counter eventually reaches zero.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A loop needs a counter or rule that eventually stops.
